legal.authority: Rights and claims before the AEPD
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Batch Downloader uses, why it needs it, and how you can exercise your rights.
legal.privacy.controller.title: Data controller and contact
legal.privacy.controller.body: José Gallardo is the data controller. Batch Downloader is a free, noncommercial service hosted on Oracle Cloud in Spain. For privacy questions or complaints, email JoseGallardoC@protonmail.com.
legal.privacy.data.title: Data we process
legal.privacy.data.body: When requesting access, your email is processed and a visible name is generated that you can change in the profile. Account ID, role, status and dates, sessions and single-use link logs are saved. Users access by email, without a password; administrative authentication uses a password hash. Your bundles, their visibility and applications, and download operational data are also saved: selection, status, progress, errors, dates and save receipts.
legal.privacy.purpose.title: Purposes and legal bases
legal.privacy.purpose.body: Email, account, sessions, bundles and downloads are used to provide the requested functions (Article 6.1.b of the GDPR). The prevention of abuse, quotas and the investigation of incidents respond to the legitimate interest of protecting the service and its users (article 6.1.f). Rights requests are fulfilled to comply with GDPR obligations. Providing your email is necessary to log into your account, but you can consult the catalog without logging in. Resend is only used to send the login email; We do not send advertising.
legal.privacy.technical.title: Technical records and search
legal.privacy.technical.body: Servers may log your IP address, date, browser, requested path, and errors. Search queries may appear in those paths and in the temporary results cache. To protect anonymous downloads and limit abuse, the service uses owner identifiers and HMAC hashes of the cookie and IP address; these hashes are not necessarily anonymous data. Semantic search runs on a local model: it does not send your queries to an external AI provider or make decisions with legal effects on you.
legal.privacy.storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
legal.privacy.storage.body: BATCH_SESSION maintains your session; XSRF-TOKEN protects operations against forged requests; BATCH_DOWNLOAD_OWNER recognizes your anonymous downloads and lasts for 24 hours. These are functional cookies, not advertising cookies. Local storage preserves catalog preferences, the language cache, and markers that prevent duplicate downloads; session storage tracks downloads and account context. You can clear them in your browser, but you may lose preferences or access to anonymous download jobs. Your session ends when it expires or you log out; local preferences remain until you clear them.
legal.privacy.publication.title: Content you decide to publish
legal.privacy.publication.body: User bundles are created private. If you make them public, their content and the author information displayed on the page will be available to other people, search engines, and link preview services. Avoid publishing personal data of third parties without a basis that allows it. Going private prevents new public queries in Batch Downloader, but does not immediately delete copies that have already been saved by search engines or social networks.
legal.privacy.providers.title: Providers and external connections
legal.privacy.providers.body: Oracle Cloud hosts the service in Spain. Resend receives the recipient address and access email content to deliver the message. Your browser connects to Google Fonts for interface icons and to application icon servers; these connections may share your IP address, browser, and technical data. Official links lead to services with their own policies. Some providers and subprocessors may process data outside the European Economic Area: hosting in Spain does not rule out these transfers. Resend publishes its data processing agreement and safeguards in its legal documentation.
legal.privacy.retention.title: Retention and deletion
legal.privacy.retention.body: Your account and bundles are retained to provide the service while the account is active or until a deletion request is processed, subject to applicable legal limits. You can delete your bundles in the editor. Installers and ZIP files are temporary: they are deleted after the save completes, the job is canceled, or inactivity limits are reached. Minimal receipts are purged one hour after cleanup; remaining terminal jobs without stored files are cleaned up after 30 days, and processed messages after seven days. An expired access link can no longer be used, but its record is not deleted immediately. Audit and some authentication records do not currently have a uniform automatic purge. Log and backup retention depends on operational settings; logging out does not guarantee their deletion.
legal.privacy.rights.title: Your rights
legal.privacy.rights.body: You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and, where applicable, data portability by writing to the privacy contact. You can change your display name in your profile; other requests are handled by email, as there is no account deletion button. We may ask for the minimum information needed to verify your identity. We will respond within one month, unless the GDPR permits a justified extension. You may also file a complaint with the AEPD. Do not post personal data or access links in public GitHub issues.
legal.terms.title: Terms and conditions
legal.terms.intro: These conditions govern the use of Batch Downloader, its catalogue, bundles and download tools.
legal.terms.service.title: Service and operator
legal.terms.service.body: Batch Downloader is a free and non-commercial project managed by José Gallardo. It allows you to explore applications and group installers into downloads, hosted in Oracle Cloud, in Spain. You can contact JoseGallardoC@protonmail.com for questions, incidents and complaints.
legal.terms.account.title: Access to your account
legal.terms.account.body: User access is done through a one-time link sent to your email. Use an address you control and do not share the link or your session. Email is used for login, not for advertising. You can change your visible name from your profile. Report any unauthorized access to the service contact.
legal.terms.use.title: Responsible use
legal.terms.use.body: Use the service lawfully and respecting the rights of other people. Do not bypass access controls or quotas, spread illegal content, or make abusive requests that degrade the platform. Technical controls may deny operations to protect service availability and security.
legal.terms.bundles.title: Bundles and publishing
legal.terms.bundles.body: User bundles are created private and support up to 100 applications. By publishing them, you make their content and the author information displayed accessible, also to search engines and social networks. You must have the necessary rights to the text you add. You can edit them, make them private or delete them; external services may retain previous copies. The service may remove illegal or rights-infringing content after examining the incident.
legal.terms.sources.title: Third Party Software, Licenses and Trademarks
legal.terms.sources.body: Each application belongs to its owners and is governed by its own license, requirements and conditions. Including it in the catalog or in a bundle does not modify that license, does not grant additional rights or imply affiliation with its publisher. Check the origin, compatibility and permissions before installing. Technical verification of an installer does not guarantee the absence of vulnerabilities or harmful software.
legal.terms.downloads.title: Downloads and temporary files
legal.terms.downloads.body: Availability depends on external sources and the checks performed when downloading. A job may finish fully, partially, or with links to official pages for manual access. Review each application’s result. ZIP files and their links are temporary: they may be deleted after saving, canceling the job, or inactivity. They are neither permanent storage nor a backup. Downloading does not replace your own review of installers.
legal.terms.search.title: Catalog and semantic search
legal.terms.search.body: Descriptions, versions, and sources may change. Semantic search provides approximate matches and may use a partial index while it updates: a new app can be found by name before it appears in AI search results. Check the application details and official website to confirm the information.
legal.terms.availability.title: Availability and liability
legal.terms.availability.body: The service may be interrupted due to maintenance, incidents or changes in providers. Every effort will be made to correct the reported problems, without promising continued availability or specific search or download results. These conditions do not exclude responsibilities or rights that the applicable legislation imperatively recognizes.
legal.terms.contact.title: Incidents and changes
legal.terms.contact.body: To communicate illegal content, rights problems or incidents, write to the contact and indicate the affected page and the reason, without sending passwords or access links. The date on this page identifies the last update of the texts. The processing of personal data is explained in the Privacy Policy.
